The area of the Blackrock Spire instance to the South of [[Hall of Blackhand]] is commonly known as Lower Blackrock Spire. Though it is often treated as an independent instanced dungeon from [[Upper Blackrock Spire]] it is, in fact, part of the same, huge, instance. The Lower Blackrock Spire distinguishes itself from Upper Blackrock Spire because it is designed for a 5-man party so none of the quests involving Lower Blackrock Spire can be completed in a [[raid group]].

==History==
See: [[Blackrock Spire]].

The orcs of the Bloodaxe and [[Blackrock Clan]]s dominate most of the ruins of Lower Blackrock Spire, but a contingent of [[Spirestone]] Ogres and [[Smolderthorn]] Trolls have each claimed a share of the area. The ruins are also home to a host of [[Spire Spider]]s. The Lower Blackrock Spire is ruled by [[Overlord Wyrmthalak]], a subordinate of [[General Drakkisath]].
